title: South Africa Actively Targeted by Nullsec Nigeria
description: Nigerian hacktivist group Nullsec Nigeria claimed to compromise SARS, SITA, and ProWellness as part of OpSouthAfrica. BreachWatcher analysed the leaked data — here's what it means for you.

title: ShinyHunters — Evolved Extortion Specialists
description: ShinyHunters has claimed ~48 victims since January 2026, exposing tens of millions of records through credential stuffing, OAuth token hijacking, and vishing attacks against cloud infrastructure.

title: Booking.com Data Compromised & Increased Phishing Risks for Travelers
description: Customer data from Booking.com has been compromised, leading to a surge in targeted phishing campaigns impersonating the platform. Be wary of any unexpected communications about bookings.

title: 2026 Data Breach Forecast: AI-Powered Threats Are Here
description: Our annual forecast highlights the most likely breach vectors for 2026: credential stuffing, AI-assisted phishing, and supply chain attacks continue to top the risk register.

title: Fake Rocket Apps & Urgent Messages Could Steal Your Data
description: Fraudulent mobile apps circulating with urgent push notifications designed to panic users into granting excessive permissions — enabling silent data theft.

title: Beware of "ClickFix" — The Trick That Makes You Hack Yourself
description: A novel technique tricks users into copy-pasting malicious commands into their own terminal by disguising them as browser troubleshooting steps. No exploit needed.

title: Unexpected Instagram Password Reset Emails & Resurfaced User Data
description: Instagram users are receiving unsolicited password reset emails linked to old user data resurfacing on breach forums. Enable 2FA immediately and review authorised devices.
